PaperMap note editor bundle: Tiptap 3.32.2 + @tiptap/markdown, built by packaging/editor (esbuild 0.28.2).
Rebuild: cd packaging/editor && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari15 --legal-comments=eof --outfile=../../src/papermap/web/static/vendor/papermap-editor/papermap-editor.min.js
